steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: So, you knew all along.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: How long did you expect this lie to last?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Ohh, the concert is about to start...

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the Obsidian Festival!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Are you all having a great time?!

steps.name: Audience
steps.text: (Thunderous cheering)

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: What a warm reception! But let me tell you something - you don't know anything about the true charm of the Obsidian Festival yet!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Tonight, all the musicians that have been invited here will come together to bring you a feast for your senses!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: One main stage. Four large stages. Twelve small stages. Forty musicians from all kinds of genres will keep the show going for eighteen straight hours until the sun rises tomorrow!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Tell me now, ARE YOU READY?!!

steps.name: Audience
steps.text: (Thunderous cheering)

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Ceylon told me about the situation with the volcano.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You tampered with the station's data and even accused Miss Ceylon of spreading false rumors.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: That's because we both know. We both know about what Herman did!
Just say it then, if you already know.
Go on, Cronin. But make sure to also tell them what you did when I was 'out on business.' Tell them everything.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: F-Father...?!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: What are you doing here?!

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Surprised to see me, Cronin?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: After I banned obsidian mining, there has still been a steady influx of fresh obsidian into the market.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: The mining team has been seen many times at the volcano's entrance, but nobody reported anything to me.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: The resources they mined would be transferred numerous times before finally arriving at the City Hall's abandoned warehouse.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Despite the fact that I set aside funding to provide support for the various Oripathy patients who came to Siesta, I learned that they were actually suffering from discrimination throughout the city.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Does this news surprise you?

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Tsk...

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Well, hearing about it made my blood boil!

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: In order to find out the truth, I pretended to leave the city and asked Schwarz to investigate for me.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Looks like just investigating these records on the relevant personnel was enough.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Mister Hellagur, you're all safe!

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: What a pity, Cronin.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Originally, I was not opposed to sharing things with you, but you were too impatient.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Me? Impatient?

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Everything I did was for the sake of this city! You were the one who taught me that!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: What happened to the Baru family ten years ago, the collapse of the television station eight years ago, and the way you persuaded...

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Or, should I say, 'annexed?' Yes, the way you annexed the Tarak Tribe. I know all about these things.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Everything I've done, I learned from you...

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Exploit, and abandon. Use any means necessary. The ends justify the means.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Do you know all the sweat, blood, and tears I've poured into this shabby hole? And what did I get in return?

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: We worked so hard to mine the volcano and finally managed to improve our situation, but what did you do? You squandered it all to subsidize those incurable Infected!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: If that's going to be the case, I'd prefer an eruption! All I need is to protect the true value of Siesta, and then I shall rise once again!

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: True that I've done many things in the past. But never have I wagered the fate of Siesta.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: What do you think about the lives of the miners and researchers, about the lives of everyone living in this city?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Cronin, you're fired.

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Ahahahahaha! You senile fool, I wouldn't be so sure about that!

steps.name: Cronin
steps.text: Thanks to your delusional prattling, my men have all assembled!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hmm? Wait a sec, how'd I burn it already?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Matterhorn! Take a look at this!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: What the heck... It feels like the temperature flow has changed...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Woaaaah! Huge waves!!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Wait! They're getting even bigger! That's way too crazy, ahahahaha!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Why are you all quiet now? Don't you normally love to run your mouth?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I'm thinking.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Huh, never thought I'd see the day when you of all people would be stunned speechless.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: My mind is racing. Give me a second to calm down.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: No, I'm not a geologist, nor do I know anything about Originium physics or high-energy Originium Arts, but...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: High-energy Arts has nothing to do with the ecology of a volcano. I doubt that stuff is going to fix our problem.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: If there's no other way, maybe I can create a giant vessel and transfer all the energy into it...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: But I'd need several years to draft Arts like that. Impossible, that's not gonna work at all.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I have no idea about any of that! But what I do know is, we're in serious trouble! Very serious trouble!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Of course we are! Otherwise, why would I get excited?!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hurry up and figure something out then!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: What do you think I'm doing?!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I need to let the Doctor know right away...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: So please think faster. I'll send the message right now! Also, don't let the heat short-circuit your brain!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I'm keeping my cool.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: You just said you were excited! Look, even your hair is on fire!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Hmm, massive geological shifts caused by a disruption of the ecological chain... Aha! It's not doomsday just yet!
